name: ISI and safety bar
description: Important Safety Information: the full in-page ISI block, and a sticky safety bar fixed to the bottom of the viewport that expands to show more.

selectors.purpose: In-page ISI section with its own background and text size.
A group of ISI content, such as indications or warnings; spaced from the previous one.
Sticky safety bar fixed to the bottom of the screen; collapsed by default.
Expanded bar showing more of the ISI.
Row holding the bar title and the toggle.
Button that expands or collapses the bar.
Chevron in the toggle; rotates when expanded.
Scrollable ISI text inside the bar.
Empty element at the end of the page so the fixed bar never covers content.

states.name: expanded
states.trigger: .{{prefix}}-isi-bar--expanded on the bar + aria-expanded="true" on the toggle
states.description: Grows the bar to the expanded height and rotates the icon.

examples.title: In-page ISI
examples.html:
Important Safety Information

Indication: Brand is a prescription medicine used to treat…

Warnings: Serious side effects may include…

examples.title: Sticky safety bar (collapsed)
examples.html:
Important Safety Information

Serious side effects may include…

accessibility: Use a <section> (in-page) or <aside> (bar) with aria-labelledby pointing at the title.
The toggle is a <button> with aria-expanded and aria-controls; script updates both the attribute and the --expanded modifier.
ISI text must remain readable when expanded: the content area scrolls rather than being cut off.
The expand animation is turned off for users who prefer reduced motion.

keyboard.action: Moves focus to the toggle, then into links within the content.

hooks.purpose: Script toggles it together with the .{{prefix}}-isi-bar--expanded class.
